repo.name: MLAtoms
repo.tagline: The periodic table of machine learning — one file per algorithm, every variant included.

tiers.1: Core — every practitioner should be able to write this from memory.
tiers.2: Specialist — the right tool for a real class of problems.
tiers.3: Frontier — recent, rare or research-grade; included because it changes how you think.

conventions.atom: One file per algorithm family. Every variant of the family lives in that file, selected by a `variant=` argument over a shared mathematical core.
conventions.variant: A named, implemented, derived specialisation of an atom, addressed as `atom:variant`.
conventions.file: snake_case.py, numpy-first, no framework imports, `python path/to/file.py` runs a demo.

chapters.purpose: Nothing here is a model. These are the atoms models are made of: activations, objectives, evaluation scores, initialisation, normalisation and the linear algebra that makes everything else a few lines long. Read this folder first; the rest of the repository assumes it.
